programme.title: Football: UEFA Super Cup – studio
Piłka nożna: Superpuchar UEFA: Paris Saint-Germain – Aston Villa FC
programme.desc: The previous fight for the Super Cup took place in Udine. At Stadio Friuli, Paris Saint-Germain defeated Tottenham after a series of penalties, even though they were losing to the Londoners 0-2 until the 85th minute of the match. Now the arena of the match will be the Red Bull Arena in Salzburg, and representatives of French and English football will once again face each other. On May 30, PSG defeated Arsenal, becoming the best club on the Old Continent for the second time in a row. Thus, Ousmane Dembélé and company referred to the achievement of Real Madrid, which after 1992 was the only one to defend the title in the UEFA Champions League era. Aston Villa won the Europa League after a 3-0 victory over German team Freiburg. It was the first international triumph for Lviv in over 43 years. There is a chance that the fans of the Birmingham team will not have to wait long for another success for their favorites. Unai Emery has extensive experience in the European Super Cup. This prestigious trophy passed him by when he was the coach of Sevilla and Villarreal. programme.title: Piłka nożna: Superpuchar UEFA: Paris Saint-Germain – Aston Villa FC
programme.desc: The previous fight for the Super Cup took place in Udine. At Stadio Friuli, Paris Saint-Germain defeated Tottenham after a series of penalties, even though they were losing to the Londoners 0-2 until the 85th minute of the match. Now the arena of the match will be the Red Bull Arena in Salzburg, and representatives of French and English football will once again face each other. On May 30, PSG defeated Arsenal, becoming the best club on the Old Continent for the second time in a row. Thus, Ousmane Dembélé and company referred to the achievement of Real Madrid, which after 1992 was the only one to defend the title in the UEFA Champions League era. Aston Villa won the Europa League after a 3-0 victory over German team Freiburg. It was the first international triumph for Lviv in over 43 years. There is a chance that the fans of the Birmingham team will not have to wait long for another success for their favorites. Unai Emery has extensive experience in the European Super Cup. This prestigious trophy passed him by when he was the coach of Sevilla and Villarreal. Will the Spaniard break his bad streak at the helm of Aston Villa, which will not be the favorite in the confrontation with PSG?

programme.title: I was the king – Grzegorz Lato | S01E02
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Grzegorz Lato won the top scorer crown of the then 1st league twice for Stal Mielec, in 1973 and 1975. He was also the top scorer in the 1974 World Cup. After finishing his football career, he became a coach and later the president of the Polish Football Association (2008-2012). Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.desc: In the floodplains of the lower reaches of the African Kuando River, called Chobe, a pride of lions dominates the local ecosystem. The clan, consisting of a dozen or so individuals, is ruled by two brothers and a brave female. The rebellious young lion Einstein stands out from them. Even though he should leave the family herd, he stubbornly sticks to his loved ones. With the arrival of the dry season, lions start fighting for survival. They try to protect their territory and offspring from rivals. When the cubs appear, Einstein decides to leave for good and start a new life. During the rainy season, the vegetation turns green rapidly, making it difficult for the lions to camouflage. Einstein tries to make new bonds, but he finds it very difficult. programme.title: 30 for 30: You Don't Know Bo
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/f Big cats of the Serengeti
programme.desc: The Serengeti is a region in East Africa that is home to about seventy species of large mammals. The documentary will introduce channel viewers to some of the most notable and interesting inhabitants of these places: lions and cheetahs. The plot centers on several families, each of them daily fighting a difficult struggle for survival in the savannah. Here are just a few real-life wildlife stories that would be the envy of any film writer. Two lion cubs, born during the dry season, find themselves on the brink of starvation because their mother Kali runs out of milk. Desperate to feed her cubs, she finds and eats the carcass of a dead hippopotamus... A lonely male cheetah, Moto, falls in love with Nyota. At first they become friends, and soon start a family. But one day Nyota disappears, and Moto goes in search of her across the endless African plains. South Korea

programme.title: NƯỚNG KIỂU TRUYỀN THỐNG - BAKED IN TRADITION (S1)
programme.desc: Trong sứ mệnh tìm hiểu lý do tại sao bánh ngọt xốp lại là món ăn được ưa chuộng nhất trên toàn thế giới, Baker Bryan Ford đã tìm hiểu sâu về những loại bánh sừng bò độc đáo.

programme.title: TOUGH LOVE WITH HILARY FARR (S2)

programme.title: BOBBY'S TRIPLE THREAT (S1)

programme.title: VÁY CƯỚI ƯNG Ý - SAY YES TO THE DRESS (S18)

programme.title: GETTING LOST WITH ERIN FRENCH (S1)

programme.title: ĐẠI CHIẾN BÁNH NGỌT - CAKE WARS (S2)

programme.desc: (Trực tiếp) Tiêu điểm về Đông Á, một khu vực có bề dày lịch sử và hiện đang giúp viết nên tương lai của thế giới chúng ta. Chúng tôi sẽ chia nhỏ những câu chuyện chính và giải thích lý do tại sao chúng quan trọng.

programme.title: BREAKTHROUGHS
programme.desc: Từ một phòng thí nghiệm định hình tương lai của năng lượng hàng hải đến một siêu cảng tự động tiên tiến, các nhà khoa học và kỹ sư chạy đua để tạo ra những cách sạch hơn, thông minh hơn để vận chuyển hàng hóa mà thế giới phụ thuộc vào.

programme.title: INSIGHT
programme.desc: Trên khắp Đông Nam Á, tỷ lệ kết hôn đang giảm. Ở Bangkok, một nửa cư dân ở đây là người độc thân. Ở Việt Nam, độ tuổi kết hôn ngày càng tăng lên. Vì sao giới trẻ không còn muốn kết hôn?

programme.desc: Sau khi bị đánh bại trong một trận tranh chức vô địch, võ sĩ Muay Thái Koy tỉnh dậy trong một khung cảnh mộng mơ siêu thực được hình thành bởi nỗi sợ hãi của cô. Được hướng dẫn bởi một người đàn ông bí ẩn, cô phải thành thạo Muay Thái kiểu Korat để chiến đấu với những ảo tưởng bạo lực và những tổn thương bị chôn vùi.
